SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN direction = 'credit' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE 
            (SUM(CASE WHEN direction = 'credit' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) - 
             SUM(CASE WHEN direction = 'debit' THEN amount ELSE 0 END))
            / SUM(CASE WHEN direction = 'credit' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) 
    END AS savings_rate
FROM transactions
WHERE date >= DATE '2025-04-01' 
  AND date <= DATE '2026-03-31';

SELECT 
    SUM(h.value) AS total_market_value,
    SUM(h.quantity * h.avg_cost) AS total_cost,
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(h.quantity * h.avg_cost) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE (SUM(h.value) - SUM(h.quantity * h.avg_cost)) / SUM(h.quantity * h.avg_cost) * 100
    END AS return_percentage
FROM holdings AS h;

SELECT 
    t.symbol AS stock,
    SUM((t.price - h.avg_cost) * t.quantity) AS realized_gain_in_inr
FROM trades t
JOIN holdings h
    ON t.symbol = h.symbol_or_scheme
WHERE t.side = 'sell'
  AND t.trade_date >= DATE '2025-04-01'
  AND t.trade_date <= DATE '2026-03-31'
GROUP BY t.symbol;
